Why this title: SayGames reports >700K event completions by Jun16 and a significant number of pre-existing players returned

Why this title: App Store promo card Apr21–May20 differs from first-party in-game duration Apr23–Mar31 2027

What NOT to copy: Do not use App Store card end date as content end date

Why this title: SayGames plans other LiveOps, including Halloween, while Barbie remains the year's IP focus
What to learn: Persistent IP can coexist with standard seasonal content
What NOT to copy: Do not stack parallel content before QA/state capacity is proven
